record_type_quote: The present study aimed to replicate and extend the study by Phillips and Cushman (2017).

targets.title: Morality constrains the default representation of what is possible.
targets.evidence_quote: The current study is modelled on Phillips and Cushman (2017) Study 1a.
targets.outcome_quote: Phillips and Cushman (2017) showed that under time pressure, people intuitively respond that immoral actions are impossible (rather than possible); we refer to this as the moral- possibility constraint. Our study replicates this constraint, in a new sample (recruited using the same methods), in a new scenario (in addition to two of the original scenarios), and for a new set of actions (in addition to the original actions).
targets.outcome_reasoning: Discussion explicitly labels the replication successful and confirms the original constraint. Unsupported new war-context hypotheses are extensions rather than failures to replicate the published finding.

reasoning: Title and both authors verified on accepted manuscript cover. Full manuscript, references and appended supplemental materials acquired via OSF primary file. Completed new-sample replication and extension; use of original data to estimate power does not make the central attempt a reproduction.
